ideas.premise: Two friends discover that every label in the school garden has been moved overnight. They follow tiny clues through the beds and learn that the mix-up may have started with an animal visitor.
ideas.title: The Missing Seed Labels
ideas.writing_hook: What clue do they notice first?

ideas.premise: A trail of muddy prints leads two student gardeners to the locked greenhouse. They must decide whether the visitor is a thief, a helper, or something completely unexpected.
ideas.title: Footprints by the Greenhouse
ideas.writing_hook: Describe what they find behind the door.

ideas.premise: A small bell rings from the garden each lunchtime, but nobody is there. Two classmates test their theories and uncover a simple secret hidden among the climbing beans.
ideas.title: The Bell That Rang at Lunch
ideas.writing_hook: Write the moment the bell rings again.
